info.title: U-net Sovereign Core V2 Public API
info.description: Public discovery, hosted verification, and exact Ledger V2 interfaces. Provider-owned login and issuance routes are described by each verified service manifest.

post.description: Create a ten-minute manual verification challenge. Public QR has no result polling authority. No holder registration.

201.description: Public challenge plus separate private result-read capability

200.description: Immutable public request and approved predicate/expiry metadata; no results or capabilities

post.description: Submit predicate and signed expiry proofs under an immutable submission ID. No holder IDs or holder JWS. Explicit retry requires consent. Proof bodies are not persisted. The UTF-8 JSON body is limited to 4 MiB in total; individual proof limits do not override that aggregate budget.

200.description: Recorded result and optional compact EdDSA historical receipt

202.description: Submission accepted or reserved; state remains pending

503.description: Retryable dependency failure; typed status is session-bound and contains no private payload.

expiresAt.description: Canonical Date.toISOString() UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

get.description: Private status polling. Capability is required in Authorization: Bearer only. Query-string authority is prohibited.

200.description: Purpose-specific active, retained, and revoked result-signing keys

post.description: Read-only recovery of an exact previously signed anchor after a lost response. The original signed operation stays in the request body, never in URLs or logs. An index row only locates a candidate; confirmation requires matching canonical chain evidence and active status. No transaction is submitted. At most eight concurrent requests per gateway, a 4096-byte body limit and ten-second total deadline apply. Responses are no-store. The result trusts the configured gateway/RPC; it is not a light-client proof or a delivery authorization.

200.description: Exact anchor evidence confirmed at the returned canonical head

202.description: Receipt/index pending, insufficient confirmations or detected reorg; preserve pending state

400.description: Invalid request; no query parameters are accepted

409.description: Exact operation evidence mismatch, reverted transaction or chain-revoked credential

429.description: Gateway concurrency limit; retry later without changing credential lifecycle

503.description: Dependency unavailable, timeout or unknown current chain state; preserve pending state
